title: Savings & Money Market Accounts: Withdrawal Allowance and Excess Fee Schedule
content:
Across all six tiers of the Savings & Money Market Accounts family, the number of counted withdrawals a statement cycle can take free of charge is limited. This schedule gives, per tier, the free allowance, the charge for each counted withdrawal past it, the most such charges one cycle can bear, the withdrawal channels that are counted, and whether overdraft protection transfers into checking are counted too.

## Allowance by tier

| Tier | Free counted withdrawals per cycle | Excess withdrawal fee, each (USD) | Most excess fees in one cycle | Channels counted | Overdraft protection transfers counted |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Starter Savings | 6 | 10.00 | 6 | the core five | yes |
| Statement Savings | 6 | 10.00 | 6 | the core five | yes |
| Goal Builder Savings | 2 | 10.00 | 6 | the core five | yes |
| Money Market Account | 6 | 15.00 | 6 | the core five, and money market checks | yes |
| Premier Money Market | 6 | 10.00 | 6 | the core five, and money market checks | no |
| Private Client Money Market | unlimited | 0.00 | 0 | the core five, and money market checks | no |

## Notes on the columns

- The core five counted channels are ACH debits, outgoing domestic wires, and transfers the owner sends through telephone banking, through online banking or through the mobile app.
- A channel missing from a tier's list is not counted on that tier. No tier's list includes internal transfers, and cash taken at a branch or at an ATM is never counted on any tier.
- The overdraft column says whether a transfer that savings makes to cover a checking shortfall uses up the allowance.
- "Unlimited" means the tier has no allowance to exceed, which is why its fee and its per-cycle maximum are both zero.

## Tier contrasts

**Which tier has the tightest allowance?** Goal Builder Savings, with 2 free counted withdrawals.

**Where is the excess fee highest?** Money Market Account, at 15.00 each.

**Does a money market check count on Statement Savings?** That channel is absent from the Statement Savings list, and the tier offers no check writing in any case.
